title: OAuth popup result message
description: What the OAuth callback page posts to its opener with window.postMessage when presentation is popup (1.1.0). targetOrigin is the opener_origin the start request named (never *). The message carries only type, flow_id and status: no code, state, token, error text or redirect URI. The opener treats the server-side GET /v1/oauth/flows/{flow_id} as the source of truth; this message is only a fast path when Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy has not nulled window.opener.

flow_id.description: The flow id returned by start; the opener polls the same id.

status.description: Outcome the callback page observed. completed or failed after the exchange attempt; cancelled when the user closed the popup before a result.
